title: SDR daily scratchpad - Ryan Park - 2026-03-07
content:
Daily goals (03/07):
- 30 total touches (calls + emails + linkedIn)
- 8 dials with decision makers
- 2 booked demos
- Update CRM immediately after each call (notes + next step)

Time blocks: 
- 09:00-10:30 — Prospecting / cold calls (high priority list)
- 10:30-11:00 — Follow-ups / voicemails
- 11:00-12:00 — Warm outreach to inbound leads (reply templates)
- 14:00-15:30 — Account exec shadowing / deal ops sync
- 16:00-17:00 — Final follow-ups & CRM cleanup

Priority list (call order):
1) Finch Health (SaaS healthcare) — CISO: Jen L. — last outreach 02/26 — left voicemail. Pain: latency on inference + cost spikes. Pitch: dedicated capacity + quantization recommendations to lower costs. Next step: send case study + propose 30-min demo. Email to send after call: short note + ROI calc (attach quantization case study).

2) Meridian Retail (omnichannel retail) — VP Eng: Carlos M. — interested in caching to reduce token cost. Had intro call 03/02, asked for throughput numbers. Action: gather throughput benchmarks from product/console (ask @Avery if needed). Aim to book 03/09 slot. 

3) Atlas Fintech (mid-market) — Head of ML: Priya S. — inbound trial started 03/01. Observed tail latency on long sequences. Offer: suggest routing policy + prefix KV caching to improve p95. Task: create tailored runbook + demo.

4) GreenGrid Energy (startup) — CTO: Mike R. — slow to respond. Last email 02/15. Try new angle: compliance + private deployment (VPC) pitch. If no response, mark as nurture.

Cold list (quick notes):
- Novus Analytics — remove from top list, low fit after initial discovery (no GPU workload).
- Skylark Media — follow up re embedding use-case, send example of embeddings pricing.
- Harbor Logistics — ask about latency SLOs; potential fit for Dedicated.

Follow-up templates (short):
- Voicemail script: "Hi <First>, this is Ryan Park from Redwood. Quick follow-up on our earlier conversation about cutting inference cost without sacrificing latency — can I grab 20 minutes this week to show a short demo? My calendar: [cal link]. Thanks."

- Email follow-up (after voicemail):"Hey <First>, left you a quick voicemail — thinking Redwood could help reduce your token spend by ~30% with batching + quantization. Attached a short case study from a similar customer. 20 minutes next week for a demo?"

Meeting prep checklist:
- Bring p95 latency numbers and current token cost estimates if customer has them
- Have 2-3 relevant case studies ready (dedicated / private / optimize)
- Ask about SLA needs, data isolation, and whether they need on-prem options

Notes from this morning calls: 
- Finch Health: reached gatekeeper, left voicemail for Jen. Gatekeeper said Jen is out until Thursday. Mark follow-up Thu morning.
- Meridian Retail: spoke with Carlos (short 8-min convo) — asked for throughput numbers. He seemed open to a pilot. Put follow-up note in CRM: "send throughput + pilot proposal".
- Skylark Media: emailed embedding pricing (sent 09:45). Watch for reply; likely to ask about integration with their vector DB.

CRM quick tasks: 
- Add tag "priority-q2" to Finch Health + Meridian Retail
- Create task for AE (Liam Carter) to join Meridian pilot kickoff if booked
- Move Novus Analytics to nurture queue with 6-month reminder

Blocking items / help needed: 
- Need updated throughput benchmarks for medium-sized transformer models (seq len 1024) — ping @Avery for access to internal runbook or console screenshots.
- Ask product for latest quantization TCO slide (for ROI email).

Parked ideas / long-term plays:
- Build a short one-pager for "Fintech RLHF customers" highlighting compliance + private deployment benefits. Could be used by AE for conversations with Head of ML/Compliance teams. 
- Create a short Loom demo (3-4 min) showing console traces + cost breakdown for a sample workload — use in follow-up emails.

End-of-day quick metrics: 
- Dials: __
- Contacts: __
- Demos booked: __
- Notes added to CRM: __

Random to-dos: 
- 1: ask Maya to share her Meridian pilot template (slack)
- 2: add case study PDF to outreach folder
- 3: prep demo environment for Atlas Fintech (ensure KV cache enabled)

Notes to self: keep call cadence consistent, prioritize decision-maker conversations early in the day, and always leave 2 follow-up touchpoints before marking a lead as cold.
